name: Shots
summary: Browser mockup generator for device mockups, images and videos from screenshots.
description: Shots creates mockups of iPhones, Android phones, iPads, desktops and websites from images or videos you drop in. It adds animated presets, video zoom and parallax effects, magic backgrounds, 3D shapes, shadow overlays, filters (noise, VHS, glitch) and custom watermarks, then exports pixel-perfect PNGs, videos or sharable links.
contains: device mockups: iPhone, Android, iPad, desktop, web
animated presets, video zoom and parallax effects
magic backgrounds, 3D shapes and shadow overlays
filters and effects: noise, VHS, glitch
pre-made layouts, custom frame sizes and watermark
export PNG images, videos and sharable links
